'''Johan Van der Meer Force Choke''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Johan van der Meer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls64.htm Force Choke], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228060430/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls64.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Johan van der Meer]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
